title: Operator-gated drain waited 1.5 h for a cutover Greg never started: no readiness acknowledgement, single relay route, no watchdog
outcome: An operator-gated hold (a drain ahead of a restart or cutover that only Greg can perform) never leaves every lane idle without an end. Agents drain only after Greg has confirmed he's ready, through a route he reads. Operator instructions go by every live route. A named coordinator checks for evidence that the operator act started by a stated time, and lifts the hold if there's none.
acceptance: The cause is recorded from evidence: the times of the restart notice, its Advisor acknowledgement, the drain and the first sign of idleness; which routes the notice and the 'restart now' signal took and whether either reached Greg's Asistant conversation, with Advisor's own report recorded if it was received or recorded as never received; and why no session acted between 17:45Z and 19:12Z. The note says which links in the hand-off failed.
The next operator-gated cutover or restart follows the procedure, and the item records that it did: the readiness reply, the two routes, and the watchdog check with its outcome.
